items.what: 能量定价实验 D-594 停止,所有人回到每条 1 Energy

items.note: Javier 11-24 决定停掉,理由不是数据而是公平性:被收 3.5 的正好是最忠实的用户,刚开始付钱(约第 30 条)价格就涨,像被误导。实测分组表 soulmap_energy_pricing_arm 最后一条是 2026-11-24 14:10:23,之后无新分组。实验整段 11-20 16:50 ~ 11-24 14:10,约 3.9 天,A 组 775 人 / B 组 793 人 / 不在实验 245 人。🛑 跨这个时刻比每条单价、能量消耗、付费率都不可比。看板第十三板块那十张卡在此之后不再有新数据。同时取消:原定 11-27 的 7 天读数和 12-04 的 14 天净收入读数

items.what: 安卓 3.9.8 上架(build 227)
items.what_en: Android 3.9.8 (build 227) released
items.note: 仅安卓,iOS 没有 3.9.8。首单 client_build=android:227 在 11-21 02:27。四个口径起点:一、client_timeout 占比从 11-21 起上升,是口径修正(此前超时记成 client_error),不是语音变差;二、ad_host_popup 从 11-21 起消失(11-20 255 人 → 11-21 48 → 11-22 10),ad_install_chat_opened 不再带 via,新增 loader_wait_ms、from_cold_start_ms;三、广告装机 10 秒内认出的直接进角色聊天,对照组是 10 秒内没有认出的人,不是随机分组,两组设备与网络条件本身不同;四、能量定价实验 D-594 的分组不随 3.9.8 上架开始,而是 2026-11-20 16:50 服务端打开时就开始(与已登的 11-20 16:47 定价实验打开同一时刻),start_at 2026-11-24 00:00 未生效;11-21 起分组量随 3.9.8 放量抬升,A / B 两组到 11-23 各约 400 人。出处:客户端周报 11-16~20、生产数据核对

2026-10-22.what: 印度以外的 A 类额度也放到 30;first_message_gate 上线(16:16);「买 3 天」通行证开始有真实购买——它和月订阅共用 purchase_* 事件,付费口径从这天起必须按 product_id 限定
2026-10-22.what_en: Type A allowance raised to 30 outside India too; first_message_gate shipped (16:16); the 3-day pass started getting real purchases — it shares the purchase_* events with the monthly subscription, so from this day on any payment metric must be filtered by product_id

2026-10-26.what: AN 渠道关停(18:30)—— 装机分母清理,整体数会跳,不是产品变好
2026-10-26.what_en: The AN channel was shut off (18:30) — this cleans up the install denominator, so overall numbers jump; the product did not get better

2026-10-28.what: 能量系统全球放开(14:21,10-26 18:25 起印度已开);14:32:20 第一笔能量入账;同日 14:21 Type B 回复变快(4~7秒→约2秒)、16:46 Type A 变慢(6.3→10.5秒),两类反向动,混着看会互相抵消;18:22 搜索全量重排不留对照组
2026-10-28.what_en: Energy opened globally (14:21; India had it from 10-26 18:25); first Energy credited at 14:32:20. The same day Type B replies got faster (4–7s → about 2s) at 14:21 and Type A got slower (6.3 → 10.5s) at 16:46 — the two move in opposite directions and cancel out if read together. At 18:22 search was fully re-ranked with no control group

2026-10-29.what: 12:14 能量改价 聊天 2→4、免费能量翻倍(之前的能量数 ÷2 才能和之后比);13:13 App 3.9.0 上线;18:11 SoulMap_TypeA_ 判 A 类、被邀请人 120→60;18:26 SoulMap_TypeB_ 判 B 类
2026-10-29.what_en: 12:14 Energy repriced: chat 2 → 4 and free Energy doubled (earlier Energy counts must be halved to compare with later ones); 13:13 App 3.9.0 shipped; 18:11 SoulMap_TypeA_ became the Type A marker and invitee rewards went 120 → 60; 18:26 SoulMap_TypeB_ became the Type B marker

2026-10-30.what: 11:57「研究」模式从入口移除,入口只剩想象/分忧/练习;11:27 Type B 三语统一到 G62Z;15:13 英语提示词改可缓存(成本降,质量无差别)
2026-10-30.what_en: 11:57 the Research mode was removed from the entry, leaving Imagine / Vent / Practice; 11:27 Type B unified on G62Z across three languages; 15:13 the English prompt became cacheable (lower cost, no quality difference)

2026-10-31.what: 投放侧:Meta 开始收到 purchase 回传(此前「Meta 应用内购买」列全是 0);🛑 Meta 收到的只有服务端实际成交的一半左右(它看到 3~6 笔/天,服务端实际 9~13 笔)—— 学习期门槛是按它看到的那一半算的
2026-10-31.what_en: Marketing: Meta began receiving purchase postbacks (the in-app purchase column had been all zeros). 🛑 Meta sees only about half of what the server actually bills (3–6 a day versus 9–13 on the server) — the learning-phase threshold is counted against that half

2026-11-02.what: 🛑 投放侧:Meta 优化目标 install -> purchase 的切换从这天开始,不是一次性 —— TypeB_F_Lucien / TypeB_F_Kabir 当天先切;TypeA_M_Divya 当天两种结果都报(347 install + 1 purchase)说明中途切。旧结构(A 类 mobile_app_install / B 类 subscribe_mobile_app)从这天起消失
2026-11-02.what_en: 🛑 Marketing: the move of Meta's optimisation goal from install to purchase started on this day and was not a single switch — TypeB_F_Lucien and TypeB_F_Kabir moved first; TypeA_M_Divya reported both kinds that day (347 installs + 1 purchase), meaning it switched mid-day. The old structure (mobile_app_install for Type A, subscribe_mobile_app for Type B) disappears from here

2026-11-03.what: 投放侧:切换进行中(Divya 退回只报 install、Sander 仍 install)。装机 630 -> 172、CPI 0.195 -> 0.605。🛑 这是改优化目标的定义性后果,不是投放效率崩了
2026-11-03.what_en: Marketing: switch still in progress (Divya fell back to install only, Sander still on install). Installs 630 → 172, CPI 0.195 → 0.605. 🛑 That is the definitional consequence of changing the optimisation goal, not a collapse in efficiency

2026-11-04.what: 投放侧:TypeA_F_Sander 与 TypeB_M_Yui 切过来。装机 75(最低)、CPI 1.051。按注册日队列的 D0 付费率已回到 1.65%
2026-11-04.what_en: Marketing: TypeA_F_Sander and TypeB_M_Yui moved over. Installs 75 (the lowest), CPI 1.051. D0 payment rate by signup-day cohort is back to 1.65%

2026-11-05.what: 🛑 投放侧:五个系列第一次全部是 purchase,切换完成(11-02 起历时四天)。CPI 1.228;但 D0 付费率 3.97%,连续四天上升(0.67 -> 0.78 -> 1.65 -> 3.97),已超放量前的 1.6~2.0%。⇒ 跨 11-02~11-05 这段不能比装机 / CPI / 新注册 / 按注册日的队列指标;能比成交笔数 / 每笔成交成本 / 每日毛额。首个成熟 D7 队列要到 11-12。另:安卓 3.9.3 也在 11-05 01:58 过审放量(当日占 59.7%,11-06 到 88.5%),两件事叠在同一天,归因时要分开
2026-11-05.what_en: 🛑 Marketing: all five campaigns are on purchase for the first time; the switch is complete (four days from 11-02). CPI 1.228, but the D0 payment rate is 3.97% after rising four days running (0.67 → 0.78 → 1.65 → 3.97), above the 1.6–2.0% from before the scale-up. ⇒ Across 11-02 to 11-05 do not compare installs, CPI, signups or signup-day cohort metrics; purchases, cost per purchase and daily gross are comparable. The first mature D7 cohort lands 11-12. Also Android 3.9.3 was approved and rolled out at 11-05 01:58 (59.7% share that day, 88.5% by 11-06) — two things fall on the same day, so separate them when attributing
